points.text: Emmanuel Macron criticized foreign leaders, including Donald Trump, for blaming migrants for riots in France and accused them of exploiting the unrest and manipulating information.
A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in a privacy case connected to the Cambridge Analytica data breach.
Russia released imprisoned American Stephen Hubbard as U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin after talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in the current outbreak, in a woman who had traveled from Uganda.
Researchers reported two critical vulnerabilities, called PHP2Shell, in PHP, a server-side language used by many web applications.
